subject: Drawing a network - vertices and edges

messages.author: 69096d3abbb2dbc3
messages.subject: Drawing a network - vertices and edges
parts:
Is there an easy way to draw a picture of a network in ggplot2?
 
That is, given a set of vertices defined by x,y coordinates and a set of edges defined by pairs of vertices, plot points for the vertices and lines for the edges.
 
eg
vertices <- cbind(c(-1,-1,1,1), c(-1,1,1,-1))
edges   <- rbind(c(2,4), c(3,1))
 
would give four vertices in a square with the diagonal edges.
 
This can be done to produce plot()-style plots with the igraph package, but I'd like to use ggplot2 so I can produce more flexible outputs.
 
Any suggestions?
 
Thanks
Ian.

messages.author: 6769cc94b93f21a7
messages.subject: Re: Drawing a network - vertices and edges
parts:
Ian,

I have used geom_segment.
You may want to take a look at this: http://sumtxt.wordpress.com/2011/07/02/visualizing-networks-with-ggplot2-in-r/

Claudia

Stanford University
